messages:
lauren: quick FYI I opened a tiny PR to update the Optimize toolkit docs for SDK v2 batching + kv-prefetch. includes a short conv-quant note after we saw an underflow in CI. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/infer/docs/pulls/4178 :link:

sam: grabbing it. CI shows the sample harness failing when prefetch stayed top-level (old API) and continuous batching duplicated requests.

alex: re: conv underflow  this happens when 4-bit conv packing computes tiny scales. short-term docs guidance: widen conv profile min, not global. example snippet below.

michael: pasting CI error log: ```
RuntimeError: quant profile scale out-of-range for layer conv2d_7: computed scale 1.2e-7 < min_profile 1e-4
 at runtime/quant.c:198
```

lauren: alex can you drop the snippet we should include in the migration notes? want a copyable JSON block for customers.

alex: sure, suggested example (to be shown inline in docs):
```json
{ "quant_profiles": [
  { "scope": "conv*", "min": "0.000001", "max": "0.1" },
  { "scope": "dense*", "min": "0.0001", "max": "1.0" }
] }
```
Add a one-liner: "Widen conv scope min when using 4-bit packers to prevent scale underflow."

sam: also fixed the SDK snippet: move `kv_prefetch: true` under `optimize:` and rename `batch_size` -> `optimize.batch.max_size` for v2. current PR still had the old key.

lauren: updated the snippet in the PR. I also added a tiny migration checklist at the bottom: 1) move kv_prefetch under optimize, 2) update batch fields for SDK v2, 3) widen conv quant profile, 4) run local fast-profile test.

michael: can we add run steps to reproduce? suggested command: `./scripts/sample_locally.sh --fast-profile`. QA used that to reproduce earlier.

lauren: added that command with expected failure and expected fix. also asked docs-bot to run linkcheck.

docs-bot: automated: docs-lint OK. linkcheck flagged a stale anchor: `/optimize/optkit#kv-prefetch` -> replace with `/optimize/migration-v2.md#kv-prefetch`.

sam: pushed a link fix. re-ran local sample, passes now. :thumbsup:

alex: LGTM from content side. small nit: add a short note about why conv scope is widened (packers + tiny activations) so readers don't over-widen profiles.

lauren: added explanation and a short caution. assigning reviewers @sam @alex. aiming to merge in tomorrow's docs deploy window (13:00 PT).

michael: sounds good, I'll queue the deploy if PR is green. :calendar:
